answer:
Headline results of run /home/hyoklee/poro/agent/results/run_20261115T155359Z_s20 (read-only report; no PBS jobs submitted, hazard.py not run):

DATA COVERAGE
- Records analysed: 759 (stride 20), spanning 2016-03-18T02:09:17Z to 2016-03-26T00:59:44Z (~7.94 days of the March 2016 Brady Hot Springs experiment; 3.314% of total time).
- Anomalous records (|robust z| > 5): 57.
- DAS detections: 62 detections in 53 records; relative b = 0.9849 (34 above Mc).
- Pumping over 15.96 days: injected 4.654e+05 m3, extracted 5.059e+05 m3, net -4.048e+04 m3 (net extraction).
- Catalogue (LBNL/NCEDC, GDR 859, March 2016): 5 events, ML -0.48 to 0.07.

CALIBRATED RESULT (catalogue-based, Shapiro et al. 2021 Eq. 5 — this is the calibrated probability):
- b = 1.0:  Sigma = -5.449, P(M>=5.5)/yr = 0.0001198, P(M>=5.5) for observed volume = 5.236e-06, P(M>=3)/yr = 0.03719
- b = 0.73: Sigma = -5.319, P(M>=5.5)/yr = 0.004922,  P(M>=5.5) for observed volume = 0.0002155, P(M>=3)/yr = 0.2809
- b = 0.65: Sigma = -5.281, P(M>=5.5)/yr = 0.01474,   P(M>=5.5) for observed volume = 0.0006484, P(M>=3)/yr = 0.4653

UPPER BOUND (DAS-based, uncalibrated magnitudes; every DAS detection counted as an event at or above the catalogue Mc, so it over-counts):
- b = 0.9849: Sigma = -2.698, P(M>=5.5)/yr = 0.07842

INTERPRETATION
- The calibrated (LBNL catalogue) annual probability of a Pohang-like Mw>=5.5 event is at most ~1.5e-2 per year (b=0.65 scenario) and as low as ~1.2e-4 per year (b=1.0), i.e. very low; the probability over the observed injection volume is <= 6.5e-4 in all scenarios.
- The DAS-based upper bound (P = 0.078/yr at b=0.9849, Sigma = -2.698) is not calibrated: its magnitudes are uncalibrated and it counts every detection as an event above Mc, so it over-counts and should be treated only as a conservative upper bound, not a calibrated estimate.
